label: Bible Study
prompt: The Spirit itself beareth _____ with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verse: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
note: The Spirit confirms what we can barely believe — we really are God's children.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at _____.
verse: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
note: Five short words of comfort: The Lord is at hand — near in time, and near right now.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were _____.
verse: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
note: Paul paid his own way: he stayed with Aquila and Priscilla because they shared his trade — tentmaking.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and _____ have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verse: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
note: Asked his age by Pharaoh, Jacob gives a weary review of 130 years — few and evil.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast _____;
verse: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
note: David looked up at the moon and stars God had 'ordained' and asked, 'What is man?' Stargazing as theology.
